data.title: bn-1n7: Palette-aware sprite and map previews
data.description: For bn-1n7: route every sprite image/GIF and map render through typed preview palettes, preserve source-zero transparency and raw authoring surfaces, add Lantern metadata, regressions, docs, visual dogfood, and full just-check validation.

data.body: LOW: The assertion says it protects the documented 'source color 0 stays transparent' invariant, but preview_cart maps source 0 to 0, so the test would still pass if a future renderer remapped color 0 before transparency handling. Set the first preview_palette entry to a nonzero value (for example 31) while keeping the source-zero pixel assertion; draw_frame is shared, so one direct regression is sufficient for sprite/map/GIF callers.

data.reason: Approved: complete static image-path trace, focused render/GIF/map/Lantern and raw authoring tests, workspace-wide clippy -D warnings, direct mapped-vs-identity dogfood for render/strip/onion/onion-all/diff/ghost/GIF/map, CLI/RPC byte equality, raw dump/lint/edit/poke equality, exact Lantern INK_MAP match, unchanged ABC/Lua hashes, and byte-identical runtime screenshots. One non-blocking LOW test-coverage note remains.

data.body: Fixed in 21bd7c2: sprite, map, and GIF fixtures now deliberately map source color 0 to nonzero Apollo index 30; assertions prove checkerboard transparency still wins while nonzero inks remap.

Verified at 21bd7c2: preview_cart now maps source 0 to nonzero index 30, and the existing exact CHECKER_A assertion therefore pins transparency before remapping. Focused sprite regression passes; original finding resolved.

LOW: This new map assertion samples cell (2,0), whose map tile id is 0. map::render skips that whole cell before draw_frame, so it proves the map's tile-0 rule but does not exercise source-color-0 transparency inside a nonzero tile as the message claims. The fixture already has nonzero tile 3 with all-zero sprite art at cell (0,1); render the second row and assert that cell remains checkerboard/not PALETTE[30] to make the map regression specific. This is non-blocking because the shared draw_frame invariant is now directly pinned by the sprite test.

data.reason: Re-review approved at 21bd7c2: sprite and GIF fixtures explicitly map source 0 to nonzero index 30 and focused regressions pass; console-agent test clippy passes. Original th-cgkgt9 is fixed/resolved. One new non-blocking LOW note records that the map assertion currently exercises tile-id-0 cell skipping rather than per-pixel source-zero transparency in a nonzero tile.

data.body: Fixed in 1ea8595: the preview render now includes row 1 and samples nonzero tile 3, whose authored sprite is all source color 0, proving per-pixel transparency matches the skipped tile-0 checkerboard even under 0->30 mapping.

Verified at 1ea8595: the rendered region now includes row 1, and sample(0,1) traverses nonzero tile ID 3 into its all-source-zero sprite art. Equality with the skipped tile-0 checkerboard under preview mapping 0->30 directly pins the per-pixel transparency invariant. Focused regression and clippy pass; resolved.

data.reason: Final approval at 1ea8595: all review findings are resolved. Sprite, map, and GIF regressions explicitly exercise source color 0 mapped to nonzero index 30; the map test now traverses nonzero tile 3 with all-zero sprite art and confirms checkerboard transparency. Focused regression and clippy pass.
